title: On subset-sum-distinct sequences
notes: docs/problems/erdos_distinct_subset_sums.md. In Analytic number theory, Vol. 1, Progr. Math. 138, Birkhäuser, 1996, pp. 31–37. q-fold dissociated sets: all sums with coefficients in {0,…,q} distinct. The q=2 case is all signed sums distinct, strictly stronger than sum-distinctness.
